content: समाविश् €6 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To enter; लङ्कां समाविशद्रात्रौ वदमानोऽरिदुर्गमाम् <ls>Bk. 8. 27</ls>. .²2 To go to, approach. .²3 To be devoted to, be intent on; तांस्तान् धर्मविधींस्तत्र भ्रातरस्ते समाविशन् <ls>Rām. 7. 10. 2</ls>. .²4 To pervade, occupy, fill. .²5 To sit down, settle down. .²6 To overcome. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To cause to enter in, insert. .²2 To contain, comprise, hold. .²3 To place or fix in or upon. .²4 To entrust, assign; यस्मिन् कृत्यं समावेश्य निर्विशङ्केन चेतसा <ls>Pt. 1. 85</ls>. .²5 To conduct, lead into.
